the effects of triazolam on the membrane properties of cultured mouse spinal cord cells.
the effects of benzodiazepines on cultured spinal cord neurons.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
triazolam has a direct depressant effect on the GABA receptor and that the depressant effect is enhanced by triazolam acting as an inverse agonistic benzodiazepinic ligand at the GABA receptor.
triazolam has a direct depressant action on GABA receptor-channels in spinal cord cell culture and an indirect action mediated by the GABA system.
the benzodiazapine triazolan has direct and GABA-dependent depressant effects on mouse spinal cord neurons and that it acts as an inverse benzodiazepin receptor agonist.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
triazolam has a direct depressant effect on GABA receptors and a direct depressant action on the membrane of mouse neurons in culture.
triazolam is a GABA antagonist, a benzodiazepinereceptor antagonist, a benzodiazepepine-receptor inverse agonist, and an inhibitor of the GABA-gated chloride channel.
triazolam is a partial inverse agonist of GABA receptors and a partial agonist of benzodiazepines.
The main takeaway from our work is that
triazolam is an inverse agonist of GABAA receptors in cultured neurons.
triazolam is a potent inverse agonist at GABA receptor/benzodiazepine complex expressed on mouse spinal cord cells in vitro.
triazolam, a benzodiazepin, is not an effective treatment for anxiety disorders.
